description: Agentic AI systems, built on large language models, are capable of goal interpretation, world modeling, planning, tool use, long-horizon operation, and autonomous coordination.

instances.assertion: Agentic AI systems are capable of goal interpretation, world modeling, planning, tool use, long-horizon operation, and autonomous coordination.
AI systems are capable of performing tasks that take humans several hours with 50% reliability.
Agentic AI systems are defined as artificial intelligence that can accomplish specific goals with limited supervision, using machine learning models to mimic human decision-making in real time.
Agentic AI systems, built on large language models, are capable of goal interpretation, world modeling, planning, tool use, long-horizon operation, and autonomous coordination.
Agentic AI systems operate with greater autonomy than traditional AI assistants, taking action to accomplish objectives without ongoing human prompting.
Agentic AI systems can operate autonomously to solve problems and achieve goals with limited human supervision, unlike traditional AI assistants.
